summary: B2Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of its annual general and special meeting held June 4, 2026. All proposed directors were elected, PricewaterhouseCoopers was reappointed as auditor, the restricted share unit plan maximum increase was approved, and an advisory vote on executive compensation passed with 70.46% support. This is a routine post-meeting disclosure; it does not constitute a special situation such as a strategic transaction, activist campaign, or management upheaval. The filing simply complies with continuous disclosure obligations.
